Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
The hose/regulator part was defective after 2 weeks, and Weber replaced it, although it took 1+ weeks to arrive, so I bought another in the meantime.  

After I replaced the propane tank, the hardware store gave me a tank that had a forward-positioned propane faucet and not the normally side positioned one.  So, when I attached the smaller hose provided for my model (and sent by Weber), gas leaked when I turned on the faucet.   So who controls the Blue Rhino tanks being sold - properly, for the right model grill?   Or does the consumer have to know the above incompatibility.  I exchanged it at the hardware store.

For an average consumer, grills are a fire hazard, and this grill is not perfectly designed, just cost-effective for all buyer and seller.  Of course, use with precaution. Always turn off the propane tank (so gas cannot flow into the grill unintentionally), or a child could turn on the grill knobs (which are fun and easy to turn) and let gas leak into the grill, without actually pushing on the ignition button to light the gas.
Results.Title: Defective Hose, & not for all propane tanks.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After having the opportunity to use a Weber BBQ at a work function, I decided to go with the Weber Spirit II E-210. Ease of assembly, quality materials and clean simple straight forward BBQ were all selling points. During assembly everything fit the way it should, which from my experience from other manufacturers is not always the case. The grill heats up very quickly, is easy to clean and the grease trap actually works the way it should! Very minimal flare ups as well!

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect grill and doesn't take up too much space. I live in the city and have limited outdoor space, but still was able to grill for 20+ people on the 4th of July with this. It gets hot fast and cooks everything very well. Excellent quality as well!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
After many years of no-brand and branded gas grills, I finally decided it was time to "splurge" and get a Weber grill. Penny-wise and pound-foolish, I had bought lesser grills over the years and also had to buy spare parts as things burnt out, corroded or just simply failed.  BUT, getting this one home... What a difference.  Previous grills with (claimed) equal or larger BTU did not heat as well as the Weber.  All the fancy talk about infra-red searing (from previous brands)... 
Now, this is a grill - steaks, chicken, salmon, sword fish... sausages...  all done to my wife's and my absolute liking!  We both look forward to "anything on the grill" now.  I will get a smoke box for it, have plenty of apple wood to use for that.  Can't wait.
Really - I kick myself for not buying one years ago, instead of all the cheap ones that have ended up costing me more money after all.
Results.Title: Finally got one!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Got this grill for Fathers Day. Lowe’s delivered it already assembled which was nice. My wife had it hidden in the garage, so after the surprise, we moved it out to the grill pad we have. While moving it, the right wheel fell off. After lifting it up, finding the cotter pin for the wheel, I installed it, and we continued to move it. The left wheel then fell off. We repeated the process, and finally got it to its spot on the pad. 
The grill lid, does not close securely, there is a gap on the right side of it. I tried adjusting it, but it won’t close tightly. 
I previously had a Charbroil Infrared Grill which I liked very much, and overall I prefer that one over this Weber.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
